svg.title: Schematic C: AeroSentry agents with a human gate
svg.desc: Schematic of AeroSentry Agents: a LangGraph supervisor exchanges work with three specialist agents - retrieval with hybrid RAG, tools with Pydantic-typed calls, and vision with VLM and thermal analysis. The supervisor's proposed action passes instrument bubbles for tracing (TR) and golden-set evals (EV), then a manually operated valve - the human-in-the-loop gate - before becoming an approved action; a branch leads to the fallback protocol. Served with FastAPI, packaged with Docker, checked in CI.
